findings.message: window.__doodley.ready did not resolve within 5000ms on desktop.
findings.fix: Ensure your DoodleyBridge sets up window.__doodley before the page loads and that the ready Promise resolves once all assets and fonts are loaded. Check the browser console for asset-loading errors.

findings.message: Page has no meta description on desktop.
findings.fix: Add <meta name="description" content="A short description of your site."> to your index.html <head>.
Add <DoodleyA11y config={...} /> from @doodley/a11y. It renders a real <nav> with one link per section.
